assets.fullbody_prompt: EDIT TARGET image1 is the approved transparent chibi Camellya/Chun cel, but the drawing ends abruptly below her chest. Keep the SAME oversized head, silver-white hair, black headband, black bow on viewer right with burgundy ribbon tipped gold, two long rectangular gold earrings, dark burgundy curled hair strands with red rose on viewer right, cheek blush and silly smile. Preserve the TWO black rounded rectangular eye outlines and eyebrows. Eye interiors must be genuinely alpha-transparent empty windows for separate eye-color compositing: NO iris, pupil, sclera, old inner colored rim, white fill, black fill or painted checkerboard inside. Most critical: CONTINUE the ENTIRE BODY below the shoulders/chest in the same cute flat cartoon style: gray and black armored bodice with gold trim and chest diamond, gray arm bracers and small hands held in front, gray layered flared skirt with burgundy ruffled underside and gold geometric trim, both legs and tall gray boots with dark soles and gold circular accents, matching reference2. Do not truncate at bust, waist, skirt or ankles. Show both boots and all hair tips with transparent margin. Preserve source2's clothing silhouette and original pose, no extra ornaments or characters. Keep original head/body proportions from full-body reference2, not realistic adult proportions. Full character in ONE flattened RGBA cel: head, bangs, hair ornaments, costume, body together; NO separate bangs. Genuine transparent background outside silhouette and BOTH eye interiors. No text, no character name, no decorative red rectangle, no screenshot UI. Output high-resolution portrait PNG, entire standing character visible.

Entire full body including both feet stays visible on portrait canvas. Output high-resolution RGBA PNG. No text, no checkerboard.

assets.prompt: Production standalone FULL IRIS sprite for the silly chibi Camellya in the reference. Draw the COMPLETE UNCROPPED iris, including the upper portion normally hidden behind the upper eyelid. Its silhouette must be a naturally UPRIGHT SLIGHTLY VERTICAL OVAL, width about 85% of its height. NOT a flattened rounded rectangle, NOT a horizontal capsule, NOT flat-topped, NOT a cropped visible eye aperture. Both top and bottom smoothly rounded. The external contour is a thin clean nearly-black navy rim, continuous around the complete upright oval. Preserve exact reference iris colors and pupil: upper half desaturated dark slate blue, lower half pale blue/lavender, straight horizontal color divide at its center; small dark warm reddish-brown circular pupil ring with pale cream center in the exact middle. No white highlights, no eyeshadow, NO eyelids, eyelashes, eyebrows, skin or sclera; no text or other objects. The final animation will put an eyelid OVER this complete iris to hide its upper portion, so DO NOT bake the eyelid crop into this asset. Outer rim, color field and central pupil one flattened sprite, genuinely transparent background with 12% padding around the FULL oval. Large high quality crisp flat cartoon RGBA PNG.
